The explicitly inspected 7x7 semilinear Cartier block matrix has A injective of rank 2, B surjective rank 2, and BA^[1/2]=H^[1/4]. Twisted products give four claimed rank profiles from H and Q=H^[4]H, with rank-one scalar factorization proving stabilization or nilpotence (finite tests alone do not). The rank-zero equation H^[4]H=0 projectivizes to [st^4:t^5:s^5:s^4t], a smooth quintic parametrization, and the cone is irreducible dimension 2 with only its vertex singular. Four free coefficient coordinates produce codimension 2 in the squarefree-octic open, and the prescribed H can always be completed to squarefree f. Independently constructed GF(2) arithmetic checked all 128 squarefree monic octics against six Cartesian-power ranks and the four cases.
